name: The Matron Protectorate
label: Quest
description: The Matron Protectorate: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Travel to Kalimdor, traveler. Our flight makes its home in the frigid landscape of Winterspring. Once you reach Winterspring, find the caves of Mazthoril.
Upon the icy floors of Mazthoril you will find cobalt runes. Hold one of my scales and stand upon a rune and you shall be transported to Haleh, our matron protectorate.
Give her the scale so that she may scry what it is I have seen and felt, here in this doomed place.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It is good to see you, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Aspects insist that we stay out of the affairs of mortals. In this world, however, such a thing is not always possible - especially when one of our own contemptuously disregards such edicts.
